title: Professor of Law
bio: Kristen A. Stilt is Professor of Law and also Faculty Director, Brooks McCormick Jr. Animal Law & Policy Program and Faculty Director, Program on Law and Society in the Muslim World. Prior to coming to HLS, Stilt was Harry R. Horrow Professor in International Law at Northwestern Law School and Professor of History at Northwestern […]
